text:
maria (SRE): FYI high rate of 5xx + client timeouts from hosted inference in eu-west starting ~00:12 UTC. Multiple customers reporting failed requests.
adam (Runtime): looking at gateway logs now. I see a pattern of \"upstream timeout\" and 502s, lots of `kv-cache miss` lines.
jules (Support): we got 3 customer tickets so far, all mention partial responses then 504. Customers: edge-heavy ecom integrations.
leo (Eng-Oncall): any recent canary or config changes pushed to eu-west in past hour?
adam (Runtime): quick check — canary traffic to model-v2 rolled at 23:55, but rollout was limited. No infra deploys.
maria (SRE): throwing traffic to fallback model and enabling extra pods in the pool to see if it reduces 5xx.
deploy-bot: canary rollback triggered by leo (Eng-Oncall) — `model-v2` -> `model-v1` (start).
adam (Runtime): rolling out circuit breaker at api-gateway for eu-west to reduce backend saturation: `cb_threshold=20`
jules (Support): posting safe customer comms draft: \"We're investigating intermittent timeouts affecting inference requests in EU. We're rerouting requests and applying mitigations. We'll update in 30m.\" Thoughts? :thumbsup:
maria (SRE): +1, send now and add note about potential increased latency during mitigation.
adam (Runtime): logs snippet: ```\n[00:13:02] proxy -> upstream timeout (kv_cache_miss=true) req_id=abc123 duration=15000ms\n[00:13:03] inference-runtime error: cache-warmup stall, queue_depth=120 model=model-v1\n[00:13:04] gateway 502 upstream_connection_reset req_id=abc124\n```\nleo (Eng-Oncall): that queue_depth spike looks like a warmup storm — many cold starts for KV cache after model swap or eviction. Could be correlated with bursty client patterns.
slo-bot: p90 latency crossed 2s for eu-west at 00:12 UTC; p50 unaffected.
maria (SRE): mitigation checklist: 1) route traffic to nearest fallback model (done), 2) increase runtime warmup concurrency to limit queue pile-up, 3) throttle noisy tenants, 4) monitor for 5xx fall.
adam (Runtime): increased warmup concurrency on a subset: `warmup_workers=8` -> `16` for eu-west pool. Watching CPU.
jules (Support): on the customer side, one tenant is doing large batched requests every minute — asking them to reduce concurrent batch size as temporary workaround.
leo (Eng-Oncall): I pushed a small runtime change to backoff cold-starts (hotfix) — no full deploy, just config toggle. Deploy-bot: hotfix applied.
deploy-bot: hotfix toggle `cold_start_backoff=true` applied to eu-west runtime nodes.
adam (Runtime): 00:28 UTC 5xx rate dropped ~70% after routing + warmup tweak. Errors persist at low levels for 2 customers.
maria (SRE): good but not fully resolved. Opening warroom tasks: triage root cause, reproduce load pattern, customer impact, and remediation plan.
jules (Support): tickets updated with mitigation notes and ETA for next update 01:00 UTC.
leo (Eng-Oncall): next steps for postmortem: capture flamegraphs, KV cache metrics, request traces for affected req_ids (abc123/abc124/abc200+). Assign ownership: adam owns runtime analysis, maria owns infra/ops mitigation, jules owns customer comms.
maria (SRE): action items (from warroom):
- A1 (adam): provide timeline of warmup_worker change, effect graphs, and reproduction script by EOD.
- A2 (maria): add autoscale floor for eu-west inference pool to avoid eviction thrash (owner: infra) by 48h.
- A3 (jules): follow up with top 3 impacted customers and capture request IDs + sample payloads by EOD.
- A4 (leo): investigate canary rollout config to ensure KV cache seeding doesn't cause cascades, propose gating changes by next week.
- A5 (support-ops): implement temporary tenant-level rate limits for batch endpoints in eu-west for next 24h.
support-ops: rate limit rule created: `batch_endpoint_concurrency=8` for flagged tenants.
adam (Runtime): reproduction notes: can trigger by hammering cold instances with concurrent batch requests that have large prefix contexts. Sending repro script in #eng-runtime.
leo (Eng-Oncall): we should add a test to our chaos harness to simulate KV-cache warmup storms. Filing ticket in backlog.
maria (SRE): postmortem checklist: timeline, impact (customers + p95/p99), root cause hypothesis, mitigations, long-term fixes, and owner + ETA for each fix.
jules (Support): drafting postmortem summary for CS handoff. Will include customer impact table and support responses.
adam (Runtime): permanent fixes candidate list: pre-warm KV cache on canary nodes, improve LRU eviction heuristics, incremental seeding on rollout, smarter batching admission control.
maria (SRE): tagging incident-critical and setting follow-up meeting tomorrow 15:00 UTC.
slo-bot: incident created INC-2026-1823456789, severity=P2.
jules (Support): thanks team. I'll patch customer comms with postmortem link when ready.
leo (Eng-Oncall): final note — consider throttling canary ramp rate to avoid multiple cold pools warming simultaneously.
maria (SRE): agreed. Closing warroom for now; keep monitoring channel open. We'll attach logs/traces to the postmortem doc. :white_check_mark:
